title: Rising river and evacuation
description: A corroborated rise starts evacuation planning; simulated responders acknowledge, report progress and complete missions.
assumptions: Synthetic exercise using cached Ratnapura roads and synthetic population, shelter and fleet data.
Demonstration thresholds and sensor-to-road mapping are not calibrated hazard forecasts.
Human decisions and responder updates are scripted; public messages are recorded locally; no hardware or external LLM is used.

expectations.reason: Hazard input must raise a trigger.
The commander must produce a plan.
A local alert or situation report must be recorded.
At least one authorised mission should complete.
